name: dungeon-map-marks
about: Dungeon floor 1, seed 42, HUD on, enemies frozen: map markers (map_marks.gd). A gold coin, a blue gear drop, a stash chest and a pot laid beside the player show on the minimap and the full map (opened with host.toggle_map: a map_view press reaches no scene in the shot tool, where current_scene is null) (debug/map_marks_check.stage/.listed), then the coin and gear are taken, the chest opened and the pot broken, and their markers are gone (.collect/.gone). An enemy shows just inside map_enemy_range and not just past it (.in_range); listing every enemy regardless of range (.plant_range) must be caught.
